model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy matrix for Mistral-0.2 as the base model, displaying performance across different specialty training sets. The horizontal axis represents the train sets—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics, and Combined—listed alphabetically; the vertical axis represents the test sets—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics, and avg.—also listed alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 40.0 to 60.0, with tick marks at 5.0 unit intervals. Each train set has a corresponding bar representing accuracy on each test set. The bars are colored a consistent shade of blue, with the shortest bar representing the accuracy of “Cardio” trained on “Neuro” at approximately 41.6% and the tallest bar representing the accuracy of “Combined” trained on “Combined” at approximately 49.1%. Representative values include “Gastro” trained on “Gastro” at 44.3% and “Pediatrics” trained on “Pediatrics” at 46.1%. The chart does not emphasize any particular bars, and no error bars are shown.
